definition: A document showing whether an applicant has a criminal record, required from applicants 18 or older for some Canadian immigration programmes, including most permanent residence applications.
longform: Applicants normally request it directly from the local police or government of each country they have lived in. Express Entry candidates who are asked for one have a limited window — 60 days — to submit it.
